origin: Exactly what it says: pull to refresh. It's credited to Loren Brichter, who first put it in the Twitter app Tweetie 2 in 2009.
whenToUse: People update manually a news or notification list where the latest items stack at the top.
whenNotToUse: A scrolled-down position must be kept, or the refresh gesture clashes with other gestures.

alternatives.name: Spinner
alternatives.reason: Only showing that a request is waiting, without a gesture.

accessibility: A refresh button runs the same action without the touch gesture.
Announce progress and failure in a live region.
